title: Legacy
summary: LEG'ACY, [Latin legatum, from lego, to send, to bequeath.] A bequest; a particular thing, or certain sum of money given by last will or testament. Good counsel is the best legacy a father can leave to

inlines.v: LEG'ACY, [Latin legatum, from lego, to send, to bequeath.] A bequest; a particular thing, or certain sum of money given by last will or testament. Good counsel is the best legacy a father can leave to his child.
